verdict.rationale: Gusto's evidence shows MCP servers that let external AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Gemini) connect to Gusto's API/data, and a CLI with agent skills for developers — these are integrations enabling outside assistants to access Gusto, not a built-in AI assistant embedded within Gusto's own product UI that an end user can delegate payroll/HR tasks to. No evidence of a native in-app chat/assistant feature inside Gusto's dashboard.
